eq-hd-ld.paragraph: From residential beds to roadside right-of-way, the work calls for more than a push mower.

eq0-p.paragraph: Comer’s flatbed hauls a tracked skid steer from job to job.

eq1-p.paragraph: A tracked skid steer for grading, loading and attachments.

eq2-p.paragraph: A mowing attachment for overgrown fields and highway right-of-way.

eq3-p.paragraph: For drainage pipe, culverts and cutting an access path.

gl-hd-ld.paragraph: Photos from Comer’s own jobs. Tap a photo to see it full size, or filter by the kind of work.
